text:
anita: customer ACME support case 19422 - streaming sessions flagged as 5xx. They report many mid-stream disconnects where client aborted after last chunk, but gateway recorded 502/5xx and billed tokens. sample request id: req_0a1b2c3d. link to trace: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/req_0a1b2c3d

mia: Billing has flagged a sudden token spike for ACME for the same window. Customer insists they closed client gracefully. :thinking:

lucy: Looking at ingress proxy logs for req_0a1b2c3d - I see FIN from client before final chunk trailer. Proxy returned 502 because backend had already started trailer processing. Attaching snippet of proxy log:
```
[2026-06-10T14:02:10Z] req_0a1b2c3d proxy: client FIN received during chunked upload, backend status=200, proxy->backend write EINTR -> closed
```

raj: That pattern matches a race between client half-close and proxy's read loop. If the proxy sees EOF mid-chunk it currently maps to 502. We should classify as 499/aborted-client and avoid billing. Repro attempt below (dev env):
```
# emulate client that half-closes after sending last chunk without trailer
printf "4\r\ntest\r\n0\r\n" | nc api.redwood.ai 443
# or curl with --no-buffer chunked stream
curl -v -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" --no-buffer \
  -d @payload_stream.txt https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

anita: customer provided a minimal repro that fails consistently in our hosted region us-west-2. They see 502 and are billed for tokens consumed before disconnect.

lucy: I can reproduce locally using the curl snippet. In our proxy the EOF path throws and we classify as gateway-error. Minimal fix would be classification change + event metric to surface counts. Will open a rollback-friendly PR.

simon: From billing POV we need a quick rule to exclude sessions where client FIN arrives before backend final ACK. Otherwise we'll need dozens of refunds. Prioritize please.

raj: Agreed. I'll spike a feature-flagged change: if client half-close observed within X ms of final chunk, mark as client-abort (499) and suppress token billing. Put flag default off for now.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for eng-runtime/499-classify-spike - env=staging

anita: thanks team — I'll update ACME with repro steps and ETA. Creating internal ticket INCD-4532 and linking billing case.

mia: tagging @simon for billing follow-up and @raj for ETA. :thumbsup:

lucy: followup: added short-term alert on streaming-eof-rate spike and dashboard. Will post PR link once ready.

anita: marking this thread escalated. closing on support side when PR is merged and billing rule applied.
